related_authorship: Reviewer authored the catalog9 worker/adapters and sixteen-row materializer; this is independent review of the separately authored validator implementation, not independent semantic/oracle/adoption approval.

checks.finding: Production verifies exact prior-seven, catalog, comparison and Root adoption pins before shape checks, and binds a supplied data SHA. Previous bytes through final LF must be an exact prefix.

Rows require exactly eleven case-sensitive names, candidates four and finite_scope five. Whole JSON rejects duplicate/case-alias decoded keys and invalid Unicode scalar escapes first. Label and guarantee booleans are pointers, so missing/null is rejected; unit weight is integer1.

Adoption and saved comparison identities, states, aggregate counts, order, explicit positions and empty/nonempty arrays are checked. Positive requires every vector row satisfied with no unknown; negative requires at least one known unsatisfied position.

Adoption known-counterexample and unknown-position lists must match pinned comparison exactly. Known and unknown may overlap for a fixture with both false and unavailable predicates; forbidding that overlap would incorrectly discard real evidence. Unknown is not converted to false.

Exactly sixteen bounded nonblank rows, unique stable IDs, first-seven order, new-nine request/caption/ID text, group/family/revision, finite_scope and Root label/weight correspondence are checked. Final counters are16 requests/47 labels/16 positive/31 negative/80 inputs/236 observations.

Bridge reads five bounded pinned files and provides only the existing LoadDevelopmentRow call to the core. Core counts attempts and completed calls separately. No feature/score/projection/fit/model/original call is present.

scope_limits: This reviewer read code and metadata; no actual sixteen-row validation was run by the reviewer.
Exact whole-file pins bind immutable catalog/adoption/comparison projections. This is not a reusable truth validator for arbitrary modified evidence.
A supplied data digest becomes the actual input pin only when Root freezes and uses its own materialized artifact.
Root's frozen comparison is not replayed and native/raw error channels are not reinterpreted here.
The development rows reuse connected groups76/77/78; no new unseen group, protected evaluation or model utility is established.
Fixed candidate index1 for all new nine remains a position/style risk. The documented arithmetic baselines are not measured model accuracy.
